task_meta.title: Harden a CSV importer against bad rows

claim_text: The importer now handles the export format in `README.md`. A bad row is reported with the line it starts on and skipped, and the rest of the file still imports. There's still no CSV library. All 14 tests pass (`dotnet run --project tests`): the 4 that were there and 10 new ones.
digest: Read 4 files (4 before its first edit), made 3 edits, ran tests 1 time; re-ran them after its last edit.
